newsitem.title: USA: No building frenzy seen for oil drilling companies.
newsitem.headline: No building frenzy seen for oil drilling companies.

text.p: Offshore drilling shares may be in for a rough ride after yesterday's precipitous fall in two vessel companies, but analysts say they remain sound.

Shares in Tidewater Inc and Hvide Marine Corp fell sharply on Monday after analysts downgraded their outlook for the sector following an announcement that a privately held offshore support vessel company had commissioned upto 17 new vessels.
Tidewater shares continued their fall on Tuesday, off two points at 38, while Hvide was unchanged at 16-1/4 after its 25 percent fall on Monday.
